newsitem.title: USA: Young boys found in garbage-filled Chicago home.
newsitem.headline: Young boys found in garbage-filled Chicago home.

text.p: The mother of two young brothers found in a stinking, garbage-filled apartment with no food has been charged with child endangerment, police said Monday.
The boys, aged four years and four months, were found with their grandmother on Sunday amid piles of garbage that blocked the door to the South Side apartment.
Police had to enter through a window after being called to the home by neighbours complaining of a foul odour.
Both boys were found to be in decent health and were put in protective custody, along with their 58-year-old grandmother.
Their mother, Liane Taylor, 24, was charged with two counts of endangering the health of her children.
